_comment: 'When this attacks a SHADOW HERO' is about the DEFENDING hero, so it is ATTACK_TARGET_IS_HERO hero_type Shadow — ATTACK_CLASS_IN asked about the attacking CARD's class, which is always Light here. Also ATTACK_REACTION on an Action - Attack never fires. Was a REF effect handed a 'target'. DESTROY_REF/BANISH_REF act on get_ref(ref), the handler does not read 'target', and no earlier effect in the ability sets a ref -- so it aimed at no object and returned. It also named the wrong ACTION: 'turn a card in their banished zone FACE-DOWN' does not banish anything -- the card is already banished. Turning it face down hides it from the effects that reference banished cards, which is the whole point.
